title: Restore Design App Selection Hook Registration
description: Fix the semio play runtime crash caused by a missing useDesignAppSelection symbol in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx. Restore the design selection hook implementation, extend existing tests to cover it, verify with targeted tests/build, and close the ticket with the touched files.
summary: Restored the missing Design app selection hook and field in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx, which removes the useDesignAppSelection ReferenceError during semio play startup. Extended the existing in-file Design Playwright regression to fail explicitly if that startup error reappears. Verified with direct package-local Vite builds for @semio/sketchpad and @semio/play.
